content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] [article_no] in use on an automation system and lately it has gone into stop mode unexpectedly. Someone has to trigger the start function to resume operation. What could be causing this? I have 10 other devices running the same program and they work without issues.

Thank you for the information. I verified that the firmware version is [version_no]. I will replace the device.

Hi, I have a [product_name] [version_no] [article_no] Firmware Version [version_no]. It seems to be experiencing the issue described above. My device is connected via Ethernet as I am trying to integrate it into another system. Is there anything specific I need to consider in this scenario?

analysis.insight_summary: Users noticed that certain [product_name] devices with specific firmware versions may go into stop mode unexpectedly, mainly during Ethernet communication, causing interruptions that require manual restart. Some firmware versions have a known unresolved issue, while newer updates provide solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect stable and continuous operation from [product_name] devices, without unexpected stoppages during Ethernet communication, and seek clear advice or solutions if such problems occur.
